title: Explain unsupported retained Git-policy paths with an actionable refusal
outcome: An unsupported retained task-attribute policy path reports its escaped spelling, the deciding conversion check and an applicable recovery action while preserving fail-closed publication.
acceptance: Both unsupported Git path spelling and non-Unicode retained-policy refusals identify the escaped path and concrete deciding reason.
Each refusal names a supported next action when one exists, without suggesting an unverified manual state rewrite.
Unsafe or unrepresentable paths still refuse before publication; targeted behavioral checks verify retained inputs and public state remain unchanged.
